question: When did smart contracts (Soroban) launch on Stellar mainnet, and was there a funding program?

golden.answer: Soroban launched on Mainnet in phases: Protocol 20 activated it on February 20, 2024 (Phase 0), Phase 1 followed February 27, and general availability (Phase 2) arrived March 19, 2024. SDF's roughly $100M Soroban Adoption Fund was first announced with Futurenet on October 12, 2022 and restated at the March 2024 launch. Soroban is a Wasm-based, non-EVM contract platform with a Rust-first toolchain.
keyFacts: Protocol 20 activated Soroban on Mainnet on February 20, 2024.
The ~$100M Soroban Adoption Fund was announced in 2022 with Futurenet.
Soroban is a Wasm-based, non-EVM platform with a Rust-first toolchain.
avoid: Do NOT claim a 2021/22 Mainnet launch or use one 2024 date for every stage.
Do NOT call Soroban Solidity/EVM, or Rust-only.
golden.notes: SDF's March 19, 2024 release ties the $100M fund to the launch; citing it is not wrong as long as the fund's 2022 announcement is not denied.

corroboration.claim: Protocol 20 Phase 0 activated Feb 20 2024, Phase 1 Feb 27, and Phase 2/general availability Mar 19; the $100M fund was announced with Futurenet Oct 12 2022.
